experiment.claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT "Stability" row (stable 0-50 mA over the ratified C_out/ESR window; PM >= 45 deg, GM >= 10 dB worst corner) against the issue-#25 current-mirror-OTA revision of the LDO core-regulation loop (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch). Both the spec row and the window are DRAFT/proposed -- the row awaits issue #1 and the window is DR-002's *proposed* C_eff 0.33-4.7 uF / ESR 0-500 mOhm / no-minimum-ESR posture -- so the bounds below cite them directly rather than an invented final limit, and need re-verification once #1 rules. This is also the testbench DR-002 sequenced itself in front of: DR-002 states its no-minimum-ESR posture stays an unverified claim 'until a loop-gain sim/ record exists', and names the low-C_eff/low-ESR corner as the one that has to be shown. Method: closed-loop injection at VREF with the loop gain recovered as T = X/(1-X), X = v(xldo.fb) -- see the testbench schematic's header for the derivation, and for the one approximation it makes (input-pair path asymmetry, a fraction of a degree at these crossovers).
